scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgYellow.bold" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,RASA,ACTIONS" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:rasa" "npm run dev:actions" "npm run show:access-points"
scripts.dev:core: npm run show:core-message && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:rasa: cd backend && "../.venv/Scripts/python.exe" -m rasa run --enable-api --cors "*" --port 5005 -i localhost --endpoints endpoints.yml
scripts.dev:actions: cd backend && "../.venv/Scripts/python.exe" -m rasa run actions --actions actions --port 5055
scripts.clean-start: powershell -Command "Get-Process -Name python,node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep 3; echo 'Ports cleared, starting services...'"; npm run dev:all
scripts.kill-ports: powershell -Command "Get-Process -Name python,node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; echo 'All processes killed'"
scripts.show:startup-message: powershell -Command "& { . .\load-env.ps1; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '🚀 STARTING AUTOMOTIVE CHATBOT PLATFORM...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host "📱 Frontend: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:FRONTEND_PORT (starting...)" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "🔧 Backend API: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:BACKEND_PORT (starting...)" -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host "📚 API Docs: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:BACKEND_PORT/docs (starting...)" -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host "🤖 Rasa API: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:RASA_PORT (starting...)" -ForegroundColor Magenta; Write-Host "🎯 Rasa Actions: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:RASA_ACTIONS_PORT (starting...)" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host "💾 MongoDB: $env:MONGODB_URI" -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '⏳ Services are starting up...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '' }"
scripts.show:core-message: powershell -Command "& { . .\load-env.ps1; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '🚀 STARTING CORE PLATFORM (Backend + Frontend)...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host "📱 Frontend: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:FRONTEND_PORT (starting...)" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "🔧 Backend API: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:BACKEND_PORT (starting...)" -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host "📚 API Docs: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:BACKEND_PORT/docs (starting...)" -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host "💾 MongoDB: $env:MONGODB_URI" -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '⏳ Core services are starting up...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '' }"
scripts.show:access-points: powershell -Command "& { . .\load-env.ps1; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '🚀 AUTOMOTIVE CHATBOT PLATFORM READY!' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host "📱 Frontend: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:FRONTEND_PORT" -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "🔧 Backend API: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:BACKEND_PORT" -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host "📚 API Docs: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:BACKEND_PORT/docs" -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host "🤖 Rasa API: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:RASA_PORT" -ForegroundColor Magenta; Write-Host "🎯 Rasa Actions: $env:DOMAIN`:$env:RASA_ACTIONS_PORT" -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host "💾 MongoDB: $env:MONGODB_URI" -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '✅ All services started successfully!' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '' }"
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.status: powershell -Command "& { . .\load-env.ps1; Write-Host 'Checking services...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; curl -f "$env:DOMAIN`:$env:FRONTEND_PORT"; curl -f "$env:DOMAIN`:$env:BACKEND_PORT/health"; curl -f "$env:DOMAIN`:$env:RASA_PORT/status" }"
scripts.rasa:test-nlu: cd backend && "..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m rasa test nlu --nlu data/nlu.yml --cross-validation
scripts.rasa:evaluate: cd backend && "..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m rasa test --stories tests/test_stories.yml --e2e --out results
scripts.rasa:train-evaluate: npm run rasa:train && npm run rasa:evaluate
scripts.rasa:full-report: cd backend && "..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m rasa test --stories tests/test_stories.yml --e2e --out results && echo 📊 Training report generated in backend/results/
scripts.retrain-and-start: npm run train:rasa && npm run dev:all
scripts.clean-start: npm run kill-ports && npm run retrain-and-start
